bijection_theorem.extra_gauge_data: NONE after origin, cyclic action, and u-ray reflection are fixed.
bijection_theorem.forward: Every cyclic/reflection-symmetric UNIT_STEP atlas yields such a nonnegative binary staircase a_n.
bijection_theorem.reverse: Given any sequence a_0=0,a_1=1 with every increment in {0,1}, define F(n)=n-a_n and F(-n)=-a_n for n>=0. The cyclic/reflection formula then gives a unique global integer atlas satisfying all UNIT_STEP constraints and the hard +u observation.

definition: a_n := n-F(n) for n>=0; reflection gives F(-n)=-a_n.
jump_freedom: No local A2 consistency equation constrains the jump bits j_n=a_{n+1}-a_n beyond j_n in {0,1} and j_0=1.
